helper.title: Privileged Helper
helper.desc: Privileged helper for one-click TUN start/stop without admin prompts.
helper.upgradeableDesc: A newer privileged helper is available. The current version keeps TUN working; upgrading also makes core updates authorization-free (written to a protected directory). Click Upgrade below when convenient.
helper.promptDesc: TUN mode runs sing-box as administrator. After installing the privileged helper, starting/stopping the proxy and switching nodes no longer prompt for the admin password repeatedly (only this install needs authorization).
helper.pathMismatchDesc: The privileged helper's registered core path differs from the current app (the app may have been moved). Prompt-free TUN start will fail — please repair.
helper.repairPromptDesc: The app location changed (e.g. moved into Applications), but the privileged helper still points at the old path. Repairing re-registers the new path; one authorization is needed.
helper.backgroundDisabledDesc: "Allow in the Background" for this app is turned off in System Settings, so the privileged helper cannot run and TUN start/stop falls back to prompting for the admin password each time. Click "Open System Settings" below and re-enable "Allow in the Background" for FlowZ under Login Items & Extensions. This page will refresh within a few seconds once it's on.
helper.backgroundRestored: "Allow in the Background" restored — the privileged helper is available
helper.descFull: Once installed, starting/stopping the proxy and switching nodes in TUN mode no longer prompt for the admin password each time (only the one-time install needs authorization).

general.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep the app running in the tray after closing the window; the proxy keeps running. Turn this off to fully quit the app when the window is closed.

network.title: Network
network.description: DNS, ports, traffic, speed test & subscription updates
network.enableIPv6Desc: Enable global IPv6 resolution & routing; may hang on nodes without IPv6, not recommended
network.ipv6NodeFakeIpHint: If the node lacks IPv6, some sites may be unreachable; enabling FakeIP is recommended.
network.speedTestUrlDesc: Target URL requested for speed testing (default generate_204).
network.speedTestUrlDescFull: Requests this URL through each node's proxy to measure TTFB (default generate_204). Supports http/https; if the endpoint is unreachable the node shows timeout — switch to cloudflare/self-hosted.
network.webrtcLeakProtectionDesc: Prevents the browser leaking your real IP via WebRTC (STUN); TUN mode only.
network.webrtcLeakProtectionDescFull: Prevents the browser from exposing your real public IP via WebRTC (STUN). Only takes effect in TUN mode. Via proxy: forces STUN through the proxy so WebRTC keeps working while hiding your real IP — requires a node with UDP relay. Block: rejects STUN outright (most thorough) but breaks P2P (may affect video calls).
network.webrtcLeakTunOnlyHint: WebRTC leak protection only works in TUN mode. Switch to TUN mode to enable it.
network.meshLoginFallback: Fall back to direct during mesh login
network.meshLoginFallbackDesc: When the selected Tailscale exit isn't connected yet, route traffic directly during login/authorization (so the auth page isn't sent to the not-yet-connected exit and deadlocks), then switch back to the exit once connected. Turn off to never go direct during login (authorization may fail instead).

proxyMode.manualProxyModeDesc: Start local ports only without modifying system proxy or virtual adapters. Ideal for advanced users configuring third-party tools.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.domesticDnsDesc: Used to resolve domestic domains. Recommended: domestic DoH or UDP DNS
advanced.foreignDnsDesc: Used to resolve foreign domains, prevents DNS poisoning (sent through proxy)
advanced.dnsInvalid: Unrecognized DNS address (supports https:// DoH, tls:// DoT, udp:// or IP); not saved, please correct
advanced.fakeIpDesc: Nodes get domains for faster first connect (TUN recommended).
advanced.fakeIpTunOffConfirmDesc: In TUN mode, after disabling, proxy nodes will receive real IPs instead of domains. Some airports with strict anti-abuse policies may refuse the connection (invalid certificate or block page), and this risk cannot be mitigated by the client. Overseas first-connection latency will also increase. Disable anyway?
advanced.fakeIpFilterDesc: These domains use real DNS instead of a fake IP. Recommended on.
advanced.resolveNodeDomainsAheadDesc: On = race multiple DoH sources before connecting; off = fall back to a single upstream. Recommended.
advanced.takeoverSystemDns: Take over system DNS in TUN
advanced.takeoverSystemDnsDesc: In TUN, temporarily switch system DNS to 8.8.8.8 (auto-restored). Recommended on.
advanced.takeoverSystemDnsDescOther: In TUN, system DNS is hijacked at the routing layer by sing-box (system DNS settings unchanged). Recommended on.
advanced.tunStackDescMac: TCP/IP stack for TUN traffic. Defaults to gvisor on Apple platforms (recommended).
advanced.tunStackDescWin: TCP/IP stack for TUN traffic. On Windows, system with Wintun gives the best performance and stability (recommended).
advanced.tunStackDescLinux: TCP/IP stack for TUN traffic. system is recommended.
advanced.tunStackDescFull: system = L3->L4 via the OS kernel stack, fastest, platform-dependent; gvisor = full userspace virtual stack, most robust and consistent across platforms; mixed = fixed combo of system TCP + gvisor UDP. Auto picks per platform (macOS->gvisor, Windows/Linux->system). Changing the stack restarts the proxy.
advanced.optimisticCacheDesc: On expiry, return the stale answer first and refresh in the background. Lowers tail latency.
advanced.dnsTimeoutDesc: Per-query timeout in ms. Empty uses the core default. Keeps slow upstreams from stalling resolution.
advanced.coreBaselineWarnDesc: Non-official core {{current}} is below the bundled baseline {{bundled}}; it may be incompatible with the new config (connection failures / missing features). Upgrade the core manually, or reset to the bundled official core in Settings · Core.
advanced.mainSessionViaProxyDesc: Route app/core update checks and rule downloads through the proxy.
advanced.localPortDesc: Local proxy port (HTTP + SOCKS5). Defaults to 7890.
advanced.allowLanDesc: Proxy port listens on 0.0.0.0 so other devices on your LAN can connect through this machine.
advanced.allowLanGatewayTip: Using this machine as a gateway requires TUN mode.
advanced.bypassLANDesc: Ranges/domains in the list go direct, not through the proxy. Turn off to let them use the proxy.
advanced.blockQuicDesc: Reject proxy-bound QUIC so browsers fall back to TCP.
advanced.interruptOnSwitchDesc: Switching nodes drops existing connections and rebuilds on the new node.
advanced.tlsFragmentDesc: Splits the TLS ClientHello to evade plaintext-SNI DPI (not encryption, no guarantee).
advanced.tlsFragmentDescFull: Splits the TLS ClientHello across multiple TCP packets, evading plaintext-SNI keyword DPI. Not encryption and does not guarantee bypass (unlike ECH/Reality). Off by default; may slightly increase handshake latency on some networks.
advanced.logLevelDesc: Log verbosity; higher levels are more private and use less disk, but record less for troubleshooting.
advanced.logLevelDescFull: Log level (applies to both sing-box connection logs and the app log). info/debug record visited domains/SNI; warn and above do not — higher levels are more private and use less disk, but record less for troubleshooting; set back to info when diagnosing issues. Takes effect immediately (the core restarts automatically if the proxy is running).
advanced.autoUpdateSubDesc: Refresh stale subscriptions on startup and periodically while running.
advanced.subUpdateIntervalDesc: A subscription is refreshed when its last update is older than this many hours (1–168). Default 12.
advanced.subUpdateViaProxyDesc: Control whether all subscription updates go through the proxy or directly.
advanced.singboxDashboardDesc: Opt-in: serve the official sing-box dashboard locally as a full-featured escape hatch for power users and debugging. Off by default.
advanced.dashboardNeedsNetwork: The dashboard is bundled — opens instantly and works offline. Click Open Dashboard to connect in an in-app window without entering a backend. The secret is the same as the API Secret.
advanced.dashboardUrlDesc: Optional. Override the dashboard assets ZIP URL. Leave empty to use the default.
advanced.dashboardRefreshed: Dashboard assets cache cleared; new assets will be downloaded on the next start.
advanced.dashboardNotReady: Dashboard assets are still downloading or need internet; please retry shortly.
advanced.dashboardCopyConnectionDesc: Copy the URL and secret to enter the backend manually in another dashboard or tool.
advanced.dashboardCopyUnavailable: Proxy is not running; no connection info available
advanced.dashboardAddressDesc: The local URL of the dashboard. Click to open it in your browser.
advanced.terminalProxyDesc: Copy the following commands to set proxy in terminal (proxy must be started first)
advanced.tipSessionOnly: Terminal proxy settings are only effective in the current session
advanced.tipPermanent: For permanent settings, add the command to ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc
advanced.tipSocksPort: SOCKS5 proxy port: {{port}} (supported by some tools)
advanced.tipDisable: To disable proxy: delete or comment out the relevant environment variables

backup.importInvalidFile: Invalid file. Please select a valid FlowZ backup file.

backup.meshImportHint: Imported {{count}} mesh node(s): using the same identity (hostname/auth key) on multiple devices may conflict in the tailnet. Consider changing the hostname or re-logging in.
backup.selectExportDesc: Check the categories to export. All selected by default.
backup.selectImportDesc: Check the categories to restore. Categories empty in the backup are skipped and your current data is kept.

diagnostics.exportSuccessDesc: Saved to {{path}}; secrets are redacted, safe to attach to an issue.
diagnostics.captureActiveDesc: Log level is temporarily set to debug and will record visited domains/SNI. Reproduce the issue then export the report; stopping the capture restores the original level.
diagnostics.captureStartedDesc: Log level set to debug (the proxy auto-restarts to apply it if running). Reproduce the issue, then export the diagnostic report.
diagnostics.captureStopped: Diagnostic capture stopped; log level restored to {{level}}

advanced.autoSwitchNodeDesc: Automatically switch to an available node if the current proxy connection fails
advanced.fakeIpFilterEditHint: One domain per line; add or remove, restore defaults to reset.
advanced.bypassLANEditHint: Route rules outrank this: to proxy a range, remove it from the list or add a custom rule on the Rules page to override.
advanced.bypassLANEditHintWinTun: On Windows TUN this list is a kernel-level exclusion: custom rules cannot override it. To proxy a range, remove it from this list (mesh routes are auto-allowed into the TUN).
advanced.fakeIpDescFull: On: nodes receive domains, faster first connect, recommended for TUN. Off: nodes receive real IPs; some strict airports may refuse, overseas first connect is slower.
advanced.resolveNodeDomainsAheadDescFull: When on, node domains are pre-resolved before connecting by racing multiple DoH upstreams for the fastest result, so a single throttled/hijacked DNS can't take down the whole proxy; when off, it falls back to a single upstream (no concurrent fault-tolerance). SNI still uses the original domain; falls back to the domain on failure. Recommended.
advanced.takeoverSystemDnsDescFull: In TUN, temporarily set system DNS to 8.8.8.8 so proxied domains resolve through the tunnel (auto-restored on stop). Off is friendlier for internal domains but some proxied domains may resolve wrong. Recommended on.
advanced.takeoverSystemDnsDescFullOther: In TUN, sing-box hijacks DNS queries at the routing layer so proxied domains resolve through the tunnel (system DNS settings are left unchanged, unlike macOS which rewrites system DNS). Recommended on.
advanced.optimisticCacheDescFull: When a cached DNS answer expires, return the stale value immediately and refresh asynchronously in the background, so the next lookup isn't blocked. Lowers tail latency at the cost of one possibly-stale first response. Off by default.
advanced.dnsTimeoutDescFull: Maximum time to wait for a single DNS query, in milliseconds. Leave empty to use the core default. Lowering it keeps a slow or unreachable upstream from stalling the whole resolution; too low may cause spurious failures. Range 1-60000 ms.
advanced.localPortDescFull: Local proxy port (HTTP and SOCKS5 on the same port). Defaults to 7890 for new installs; used by both system proxy and terminal proxy.
advanced.blockQuicDescFull: Reject proxy-bound QUIC (UDP 443) so browsers fall back to TCP. Fixes pages stalling when a node's UDP relay is unreliable. Off by default; applies to all nodes.
advanced.interruptOnSwitchDescFull: Default is graceful switching: switching nodes does not restart the proxy and existing connections persist until they close naturally; new connections use the new node. When enabled, switching forcibly drops existing connections and rebuilds them on the new node immediately.
advanced.subUpdateViaProxyDescFull: Follow subscription settings (default): each subscription decides via its own "Update via proxy" switch. All via proxy: every subscription is forced through the running proxy, ignoring per-subscription settings. All direct: every subscription is forced direct, ignoring per-subscription settings.
advanced.mainSessionViaProxyDescFull: When on, app/core update checks and rule-resource downloads go through the proxy while it runs (update sources are mostly on GitHub); when off, they go direct / via system proxy. Note: under TUN mode, OS-level capture means off cannot fully bypass the proxy.
advanced.disableLogFileDescFull: Fully disables sing-box logging (privacy / disk). In-app real-time logs and log-based diagnostics become unavailable; crash detection still works. Applies automatically by restarting the proxy after save (when running).
advanced.fakeIpFilterDescFull: These domains use real DNS instead of a fake IP (clock sync, connectivity checks and lock-screen login break with fake IPs). Recommended on.
advanced.allowLanGatewayTipFull: Using this machine as a gateway (other devices set it as Gateway + DNS) requires TUN mode: it auto-enables IP forwarding and serves DNS on port 53.
advanced.neighborDomainsDesc: Resolve single-label short names under these suffixes via LAN neighbor resolution (hostname → IP).
advanced.neighborDomainsDescFull: When this machine acts as a LAN gateway, dot-less short names under the configured suffixes (e.g. nas.lan) are resolved to LAN device IPs via DHCP neighbor info, no manual hosts needed. Each suffix is auto-prefixed with a dot; Linux/macOS only.
advanced.neighborDomainsHint: One suffix per line (leading dot added automatically); dot-less short names under it (e.g. nas.lan) resolve via LAN devices.
advanced.tunInboundExcludeDesc: When these networks connect in to this machine (e.g. reaching a local service via mesh/NAT), let reply traffic bypass TUN and use the physical interface, so the connection isn't hijacked and dropped.
advanced.tunInboundExcludeDescFull: Unlike "Bypass LAN" (a routing direct-connect preference that does not affect whether traffic enters TUN), this excludes the networks from TUN capture directly. Note this is BIDIRECTIONAL — an excluded range bypasses TUN in both directions (outbound too), so it can no longer be routed through a proxy/custom rule. Ranges overlapping mesh (WireGuard/Tailscale) routes are skipped automatically (mesh wins); on macOS the machine's own physical LAN is skipped. Most users don't need this.
advanced.tunInboundExcludeHint: One CIDR per line; invalid entries are dropped on save. For "this machine is remotely managed / connected in to" scenarios.
advanced.tunInboundExcludePlaceholder:
One IP range (CIDR) per line, e.g.:
10.147.0.0/16
192.168.5.0/24
advanced.macFilterDesc: Limit or exclude which LAN devices' traffic enters the TUN (by MAC).
advanced.macFilterDescFull: When this machine acts as a LAN gateway, limit (“only allow”) or exclude device traffic from the TUN tunnel by MAC. Linux only; requires auto_route (auto_redirect is enabled automatically). Set this machine as the gateway on your router.
advanced.macFilterHint: One MAC per line (00:11:22:33:44:55); requires auto_route, Linux only.
advanced.nodeResolverRaceHint: Pick the encrypted upstreams (DoH/DoT) that race concurrently, up to 3.
advanced.nodeResolverFallbackHint: Used only if all DoH fail; doesn't count toward the limit.
advanced.nodeResolverErrDomain: Only plain IPs are supported, not domains
advanced.nodeResolverSingleHint: Single upstream, no concurrent fault-tolerance (falls back to a single DNS).

servers.multiplexDesc: Reuses multiple connections over a single tunnel, reducing handshake overhead and resisting connection fingerprinting.
servers.multiplexDisabled: Multiplex is incompatible with the current configuration and has been disabled.
servers.multiplexPaddingDesc: Pads traffic with random data to strengthen fingerprint resistance (slight overhead).
servers.multiplexVisionConflict: Multiplex is incompatible with the xtls-rprx-vision flow and has been disabled.
servers.hopPortsDesc: Comma-separated port ranges, e.g. 20000:30000,40000:50000. Leave blank to disable.
servers.hopIntervalDesc: Interval between port hops, e.g. 30s. Leave blank for the default.
servers.serverAddressDesc: Use domain name or IP address
servers.sniDesc: TLS Server Name Indication, leave empty to use server address
servers.subNodeEditHint: This node belongs to a subscription; edits are overwritten on the next update. For lasting changes, use "Clone to Manual Nodes".
servers.deleteServerDesc: Are you sure you want to delete server "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
servers.batchDeleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete the selected {{count}} manually added nodes? This action cannot be undone.
servers.noServersDesc: No servers added yet. Click the button above to add your first one.
servers.noSubNodesDesc: This subscription has no nodes yet. Click the Update Nodes button above to fetch the latest data.
servers.noMatchingDesc: Try adjusting your search keywords or filters.
servers.deleteSubDesc: Are you sure you want to delete subscription "{{name}}"? This will also delete all {{count}} nodes under it. This action cannot be undone.
servers.nodeInvalid: Invalid node config, skipped at startup
servers.deleteFailDesc: An error occurred while deleting the server
servers.selectFailDesc: An error occurred while selecting the server
servers.saveFailDesc: An error occurred while saving the server
servers.tailscaleSingleOnly: Only one Tailscale node per device. All accounts share the same address range, so a second one just shadows the first. Remove the existing one to switch accounts.
servers.remarksDesc: Set a recognizable name for the server
servers.passwordDesc: The connection password configured on the server
servers.grpcServiceNameDesc: gRPC service_name; must match the server.
servers.editServerDesc: Modify server configuration. Proxy will not restart automatically after saving.
servers.addServerDesc: Add a proxy or mesh server. Choose the type under Protocol below.
servers.protocolLockedOnEdit: Protocol cannot be changed when editing — delete and re-add to switch.
servers.detourDesc: Connect to this node through another proxy server (proxy chain)
servers.flowDesc: XTLS flow control, Reality recommends xtls-rprx-vision
servers.enableShadowTlsDesc: Wrap Shadowsocks with a TLS obfuscation tunnel
servers.tuicZeroRttDesc: Enable 0-RTT QUIC handshake to cut connection latency; carries a replay-attack risk, enable as needed.
servers.tuicHeartbeatDesc: Keep-alive heartbeat interval, e.g. 10s. Empty uses the core default (10s).
servers.nameDuplicate: A node with this name already exists (allowed, just harder to tell apart when switching)
servers.echConfigDesc: Leave empty to auto-load from DNS (HTTPS record); paste ECHConfigList (PEM) to set explicitly
servers.wgIntro: WireGuard node: reach a peer LAN, or act as an internet exit.
servers.wgConfParseFailed: Could not parse the .conf — please fill the fields manually
servers.warpPanelIntro: One click registers an anonymous Cloudflare WARP device and adds it as a node — no keys or settings to fill in. Edit it later to fine-tune routing.
servers.warpNameFirst: Enter a node name above first
servers.customIntro: Paste a raw sing-box outbound JSON (e.g. snell).
servers.customJsonInvalid: Invalid JSON — must be an object with a "type" field
servers.customIncompatible: Not supported by the current kernel (needs a compatible third-party kernel)
servers.customIsEndpointDesc: Enable if this type belongs to sing-box endpoints[] (wireguard/tailscale-like) instead of outbounds[].
servers.customSecretKeysDesc: Keys treated as secrets when exporting diagnostics (the whole JSON is masked by default).
servers.alwaysRouteSubnetsDesc: On: the subnets below are always reachable through this node. Off (egress-only): routed only when this node is the active exit or a rule targets it.
servers.alwaysRouteSubnetsTsDesc: On: the tailnet and routed subnets are always reachable. Off (egress-only): routed only when this node is the active exit or a rule targets it.
servers.allowInternetOffHint: Internet access off: this node only routes the subnets listed above.
servers.allowInternetOffNoRoutes: ⚠ This node currently carries no traffic (no subnets listed). Add a subnet, or turn on internet access.
servers.accessModeUserspaceDesc: gVisor userspace netstack — no privileges; outbound / access only.
servers.accessModeSystemTunOnly: System needs TUN mode; in non-TUN it runs as gVisor (your setting is kept and restored when you switch back to TUN).
servers.accessModeWindowsGvisorOnly: Windows supports gVisor only — runs as a userspace netstack (outbound / access; no kernel interface).
servers.accessModeSystemDesc: System: real kernel interface — reachable by other devices, can route for subnets (needs helper + TUN).
servers.wgFullTunnel: Route all internet via this node
servers.wgFullTunnelDesc: All internet egresses via this WireGuard node (this node is the exit); off = only route the subnets below.
servers.meshShadowedTip: These subnets are already claimed by an earlier mesh node and won't route via this one: {{cidrs}}. Dedupe / reorder nodes / override with a custom rule.
servers.wgAllowedIPsDesc: Subnets (CIDR) to route through this node. Empty = full tunnel.
servers.tsIntro: Tailscale is account-based — no address/port. Paste an auth key, or start the node to get a login URL.
servers.tsExitNodeDesc: Route all internet traffic through this device.
servers.tsExitNodeAllowLan: Allow LAN access via exit node
servers.tsExitNodeAllowLanDesc: When using an exit node, still reach the local LAN directly instead of routing it through the exit.
servers.tsAcceptRoutesDesc: Use subnet routes advertised by other nodes.
servers.tsControlUrlDesc: Custom control server (Headscale). Empty = Tailscale default.
servers.tsAdvertiseRoutesDesc: Advertise this machine's physical subnets to the tailnet (subnet router). Comma-separated.
servers.tsEphemeralDesc: Auto-remove this node from the tailnet when offline.
servers.tsAdvertiseTagsDesc: ACL tags this node advertises to the tailnet (tag:*). Comma-separated.
servers.tsRelayServerPortDesc: Listen port to act as a peer relay (inbound relay). Empty = off.
servers.tsSshServerDesc: Run a Tailscale SSH server on this node (tailnet:22, access governed by ACLs).
servers.tsResolveByNameDesc: Resolve tailnet short names / MagicDNS names via this node (accept_search_domain + preferred_by). Coexists with your normal DNS — only tailnet names use it. Effective only when this node is the selected exit.
servers.tsAcceptDefaultResolversDesc: Also accept the default DNS resolvers pushed by the tailnet (split-DNS). Optional.
servers.tsLoginNeededDesc: Complete Tailscale authentication in your browser to join (first time only).
servers.tsLoginNowDesc: Open the browser now to complete Tailscale login (no auth key needed).
servers.tsLoggingInDesc: Browser opened — finish the authorization; status updates automatically on success.
servers.tsLoginOpeningDesc: Opening the browser to complete login. Authorize there, then come back.
servers.tsLoginAlready: Tailscale node "{{name}}" is already logged in
servers.tsLoginInProgress: Login for "{{name}}" is already in progress

naive.useHttp3Desc: Dial this node over QUIC/UDP (server must enable HTTP/3).
naive.useHttp3DescFull: This node dials over QUIC/UDP (server must listen on quic://, with HTTP/3 enabled). Its own QUIC dial is protected and not killed by "Block QUIC"; browser QUIC to this node is still handled per the "Block QUIC" setting.

ssh.userDesc: SSH login user, defaults to root
ssh.privateKeyPathDesc: Absolute path to the private key file; leave empty to use the inline key below
ssh.privateKeyDesc: Paste the private key content directly (the private key path takes precedence)
ssh.hostKeyDesc: Leave empty to accept all host keys (not recommended in production). Run ssh-keyscan host to obtain one.
ssh.hostKeyAlgorithmsDesc: Restrict acceptable host-key algorithms, comma/newline separated. Empty uses core defaults.
ssh.clientVersionDesc: SSH client version identifier string. Empty uses the core default.
ssh.cipherDesc: Symmetric ciphers (comma/newline separated). Empty uses the default set. sing-box field: cipher.
ssh.macDesc: Message authentication algorithms (comma/newline separated). Empty uses the default set. sing-box field: mac.
ssh.kexAlgorithmDesc: Key exchange algorithms (comma/newline separated). Empty uses the default set. sing-box field: kex_algorithm.

anytls.idleCheckIntervalDesc: How often to check idle sessions, e.g. 30s. Empty uses the core default.
anytls.idleTimeoutDesc: Close a session after it stays idle this long, e.g. 30s. Empty uses the core default.
anytls.minIdleSessionDesc: Minimum idle sessions to keep open. Default 0.

servers.tsAuthKeyDescFull: Pre-auth key for non-interactive login. Leave empty to log in via URL on start.
servers.tsExitNodeDescFull: Pick a tailnet device as the exit; all internet traffic egresses through it (full proxy). Empty = tailnet / accepted subnet routes only.
servers.tsRoutesDescFull: Send these advertised subnets (e.g. 192.168.50.0/24) through this Tailscale node; tailnet 100.64.0.0/10 is auto-included. Comma-separated. Setting this auto-enables Accept Routes.
servers.echDescFull: Encrypts the ClientHello and hides the SNI to bypass SNI-based blocking. Requires server/DNS ECH support.
servers.wgAllowedIPsDescFull: Subnets (CIDR) to route through this node, comma/newline-separated. For peer LAN only, list specific CIDRs like 10.8.0.0/24. Empty = full tunnel (all traffic) — only when 'Allow internet access' is on.
servers.customIntroFull: Paste a raw sing-box outbound JSON (e.g. snell). Compatibility is checked against the current kernel; an incompatible protocol needs a third-party kernel that supports it.
servers.httpsEnableDesc: Enable TLS encryption for this proxy
servers.bandwidthDesc: Declared link bandwidth (Mbps); leave empty to use BBR congestion control.
servers.tsConnCardLoggingInDesc: Waiting for browser authorization — click Open login page if needed; connects automatically after you authorize.
servers.tsConnCardIntro: Account-based mesh: log in to join this device to your tailnet
servers.tsConnCardKeyReadyDesc: Connects automatically when the proxy starts — no login needed
servers.tsConnCardSettingsDesc: Exit node, subnet routing and advanced options. Saving while the proxy is running auto-reconnects to apply.
servers.tsConnCardDeleteDesc: Logs out and removes this Tailscale node config. You can reconnect anytime.
servers.meshAccessDesc: Add this device to a mesh: account-based Tailscale, or node-based WireGuard / WARP
servers.meshAccessTsExists: Tailscale already connected — see the card above
servers.meshAccessAddWgDesc: Fill in manually or paste a wg-quick .conf to import.
servers.meshAccessAddWarpDesc: One click registers an anonymous WARP device and adds it as a WireGuard node.
servers.tsLogoutRestartHint: Node is running; restart the proxy to take effect
servers.tsLoggedInNoKeyHint: Logged in — no auth key needed
servers.obfsTypeDesc: Salamander or Gecko (sing-box 1.14). Gecko adds random packet-size padding.
servers.obfsPacketSizeDesc: Random padding length range for Gecko obfuscation. Empty uses the core default.
servers.obfsPacketSizeOrder: Max packet size must be ≥ min packet size
servers.bbrProfileDesc: BBR congestion-control profile (sing-box 1.14). Default uses the core congestion control.
servers.tlsEngineDesc: TLS stack engine. System-native stacks (Schannel / Network.framework) make handshake fingerprints more realistic; available only on the matching platform.
servers.tlsSpoofDesc: Sends a forged ClientHello (with a decoy SNI) before the real handshake to bypass SNI-filtering middleboxes. Requires elevated privileges (CAP_NET_RAW+NET_ADMIN / root / Administrator).
servers.tlsSpoofDescFull: Anti-censorship: before the real TLS handshake, send a fake ClientHello using a decoy (whitelisted) SNI to trick SNI-blocking middleboxes into letting the connection through. Limits: needs elevated privileges (Linux CAP_NET_RAW+NET_ADMIN / macOS root / Windows Administrator), not supported on ARM64, the decoy SNI must be a domain (not an IP literal) and must differ from the real server name.
servers.tlsSpoofArchUnsupported: TLS spoof is not supported on ARM64 (the core implements it only on amd64).
servers.tlsSpoofSniDesc: Decoy domain used in the forged ClientHello (e.g. a whitelisted site). Must be a domain (not an IP) and must differ from the real server name; leave empty to disable spoof.
servers.tsExitNodeNoneHint: No exit node — tailnet / LAN access only
servers.warpLicenseHint: Leave empty for free WARP; enter a license to register as WARP+.
servers.warpApplyPlusDesc: Upgrade in place (no re-register). To downgrade, delete this node and add a free one.
servers.warpPlusLegacyHint: This WARP node has no stored credentials (legacy) — to use WARP+, delete it and re-create.
servers.warpPlusMaybeFree: License submitted, but still free — check the license key.
servers.meshLoginFallbackDesc: The selected Tailscale exit isn't connected yet, so traffic goes directly during login/authorization; it switches back to the exit automatically once connected.
servers.meshLoginFallbackRestored: Connected to {{name}}, routing switched back to this exit

typeHints.domainSuffix: One domain per line (matches it and all subdomains)
typeHints.domainKeyword: One keyword per line; matches if the domain contains it
typeHints.domainRegex: Golang RE2 regex; no lookahead / backreferences
typeHints.ipCidr: One per line; a bare IP means a single host; IPv4/IPv6 both OK

typeHints.processPath: One full process path per line

typeHints.geoip: One tag per line (e.g. cn), or pick from common tags below

rules.appRulesDesc: Quickly set proxy policies for popular apps
rules.appRoutingDisabledHint: App routing is off: all apps follow the current routing policy and the rules below have no effect.
rules.targetMissingTip: The selected node was deleted; at runtime it falls back to following the global selected node.
rules.resourceMissingTip: This rule references a rule resource that is missing (deleted or file lost); it is currently inactive. Re-download it on the Rule Resources page to restore.
rules.meshOverlapTip: This rule's CIDR overlaps a mesh (WireGuard/Tailscale) route segment; with higher priority it overrides the mesh route, so that segment may not go through the mesh node. Adjust if unintended.
rules.meshOverlapHint: CIDR {{values}} overlaps a mesh (WireGuard/Tailscale) route segment: this rule has higher priority and will override the mesh route, so that segment may not go through the mesh node. Adjust if unintended.
rules.priorityFlow: Priority (high to low): custom rules → app routing → mesh (WireGuard/Tailscale) → bypass LAN → smart routing → default. Earlier matches first; your custom rules rank highest.
rules.smartOnlyHint: Not active in the current mode — only Smart mode applies.
rules.appGeoMissingTip: This app references a routing rule-set that is missing (deleted or file lost); only process-name matching is active. Re-download it on the Rule Resources page to restore.
rules.regionRoutingDesc: Auto-route by region: local direct, overseas via proxy. Only in Smart mode.
rules.regionReverseDesc: Local via proxy, overseas direct — access the selected region's local content from abroad.
rules.orderConflict: Rules changed elsewhere; exited order editing.
rules.customRulesDesc: Manage domain, IP/port, process and rule-set routing rules
rules.ruleListDesc: Custom rules and app routing apply only in Smart mode: Global routes everything through the selected node, Direct connects everything directly.
rules.addFirstRule: Click the button above to add your first rule
rules.enableRuleTip: Disabled rules will not take effect
rules.bypassFakeIpTip: Resolve matched domains to their real IP instead of a fake IP. A few QUIC/UDP services (e.g. Cloudflare Tunnel) need this; off by default.
rules.bypassFakeIpDisabledTip: FakeIP is globally disabled in Settings - Network, so this switch has no effect (no traffic goes through FakeIP).
rules.saveErrorDesc: An error occurred while saving the rule
rules.errorEmpty: Please enter at least one domain or IP CIDR
rules.instruction1: · Rules span five groups (Domain / IP·Port / LAN Device / Process / Rule Set) with 15 types; a rule can combine multiple conditions (match any by default, or switch to match all), one match value per line
rules.instruction2: · "Domain Suffix" matches the domain and all subdomains (recommended); "Domain" matches exactly, no subdomains
rules.instruction3: · Process rules apply only to locally-originated connections (Windows names include .exe); "Process Name + Direct" lets an app bypass the proxy
rules.instruction4: · Rules match top-to-bottom, first match wins; custom rules take precedence over app policy and smart routing; custom rules and app policy apply only in Smart mode (Global routes all traffic through the selected node, Direct connects directly)
rules.instruction5: · "Rule Set" accepts a remote URL (.srs/.json), or reference a local resource downloaded on the Rule Resources page; for Geosite/GeoIP enter a tag (e.g. youtube / cn)
rules.instruction6: · Bypass FakeIP: Uses real DNS resolution, domain rules only, suitable for QUIC/UDP protocols (like Cloudflare Tunnel)

If the proxy isn't running, this round is skipped and retried once it's up. Takes effect only when the global "Fetch subscriptions through proxy" is set to "Follow subscription settings".
